subject.description: A single happy, gender-neutral cartoon child around 9 years old performing a confident horizontal parkour leap (long jump / flying vault), arms outstretched for balance, one leg tucked, the other extending forward, body angled diagonally as if soaring through the air
subject.appearance: Light tan skin, short tousled brown hair blown back by motion, joyful big smile, bright eyes looking forward with excitement
subject.outfit: Bright electric blue (#006AFF) athletic t-shirt with a small white stencil 'PKBA' detail on the chest, warm yellow (#FFD23F) athletic shorts, clean white sneakers with subtle coral-red (#FF6B6B) stripes
subject.proportions: Slightly chunky stylized cartoon proportions — big expressive head, energetic limbs, kid-friendly anatomy. Keep style consistent with a previous reference: clean flat cartoon, bold navy outlines.

scene.setting: A bright sunny summer day on the French Atlantic coast (Bassin d'Arcachon vibe). The child is mid-leap above a weathered wooden beach pier / boardwalk, with a sandy dune on one side and calm turquoise lagoon water on the other
scene.foreground: Wooden plank boardwalk seen in slight diagonal perspective. A red-and-white striped beach umbrella tilted to the left, a colorful striped beach towel folded on the planks, a small wicker beach basket with a baguette poking out as a subtle French seaside detail
scene.midground: Soft yellow sand dune with tufts of green dune grass, a few smooth round pebbles, one open beach chair in yellow and coral facing the water
scene.background: Calm pale turquoise lagoon water with very gentle ripples, soft sandy shoreline in the distance, fluffy white cumulus clouds in a vibrant pale sky blue (#A8D8FF) sky, a large warm yellow (#FFD23F) flat cartoon sun in the upper-left with simple straight rays, two tiny stylized seagulls (white V-shapes) gliding in the sky

style.lineWork: Bold clean dark navy (#0A1F4D) outlines, consistent moderate weight, slightly thicker on the main character for emphasis
style.shading: Single soft cell-shaded shadow layer per element, no gradients, no painterly textures, no 3D rendering
style.references: Contemporary children's book illustration, modern editorial flat illustration, Dribbble-style flat character art, warm and wholesome
style.exclusions: NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D rendered, NOT anime, NOT painterly, NOT watercolor, NOT pixel art, NOT sketchy

composition.framing: Square 1:1 aspect ratio, full-bleed scene with no white border, no frame, no margin
composition.subjectPlacement: Child is the dominant focal point, centered horizontally and vertically, sized to occupy roughly 55% of the canvas diagonal, leaping diagonally from lower-left to upper-right
composition.depth: Clear foreground / midground / background separation through scale and atmospheric perspective (background slightly desaturated)
composition.motionLines: 3 to 5 short curved white motion lines trailing behind the child's limbs to reinforce speed and direction of the leap

colorPalette.secondary: #FFD23F warm yellow (shorts, sun, beach chair, sand highlights)
colorPalette.accent: #FF6B6B coral red (umbrella stripes, shoe stripes, towel stripes)
colorPalette.skyAndSand: #A8D8FF soft pale sky blue and #F4E9D0 warm sand cream
colorPalette.neutral: #FFFFFF white (clouds, motion lines, sneakers) and #0A1F4D dark navy (outlines, deep shadows)
colorPalette.rule: Limit total colors to this restricted palette plus natural light skin tones — no neon, no muddy tones, no extra colors

lighting.type: Bright midday summer sunlight, single warm directional light source coming from the upper-left
lighting.mood: Cheerful, joyful, full of vacation energy, totally safe and inviting for families

mood.feeling: Carefree summer vacation joy meets sporty adventure, designed to make parents instantly feel parkour is fun, safe, and an obvious holiday activity for their kids
mood.tone: Wholesome, family-friendly, energetic, sunny, optimistic, French Atlantic seaside

technical.format: Square 1:1 PNG, 2048x2048 resolution, sharp clean edges, no compression artifacts
technical.usage: Will be placed as the central hero illustration on a printed A5 flyer and a 1080x1080 Instagram post for a parkour club aimed at tourist families visiting the Bassin d'Arcachon

avoid: Dark, moody, stormy or anxiety-inducing tones
Weapons, fearful expressions, aggressive or risky-looking poses
Adult bystanders or any other characters
Recognizable real brand logos other than the small white 'PKBA' chest detail
Text, captions, watermarks, signatures, speech bubbles
Cluttered busy backgrounds with too many props
Crashing waves, surf, stormy weather, dramatic skies
Cars, roads, buildings, or urban elements
Realistic skin texture, freckles in excess, facial wrinkles
White frame, polaroid border, sticker outline around the image
